questions.learningObjective: Analyze how byte order applies in a computing setting.

stimulus.body: Working set: 899 values under review for byte order.

questions.stem: An audit samples 899 values where byte order is relevant. Which statement about byte order does this account support?

options.text: Order of bits within one byte
options.misconception: Confuses byte order with bit order

options.text: Order of characters in a string
options.misconception: Confuses byte order with text order

options.text: Order of packets on a network
options.misconception: Confuses byte order with packet order

options.text: Order of bytes in a multi byte value

questions.explanation: byte order: Endianness is the order in which bytes of a multi byte value are stored, either most significant or least significant first. With 899 values in view, that principle distinguishes the correct choice; every other option rests on a specific misconception.
questions.hint: What is ordered when storing a 32 bit integer?
